title: 第三十章 沼泽
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
见对方只是静静看着，不发一言，魁梧体修咬紧后槽牙，面容因极力克制更为扭曲，喘着粗气：“您，这般年纪……呃……便知晓此毒草。”他又闷哼一声，鲜红的血迹从他唇角溢出，“道祖……道祖，那般人物……呃……定能，救……”

    话音未落，更多的鲜血从他口中流出，谢清猗稍稍别开眼，没握剑的的手，指尖深深陷入肉中，她睫毛轻颤，虽然这人前面嘲讽她，可她真是一点办法也无，师尊，她不知道能否救的了他们……

    沈江寒眸光冷了下来，法袍随着他的动作轻拂，向前一步挡住谢清猗，清朗的嗓音沉了下来：“先前不让摘，如今这般，又来为难我师妹。”

    “确实，师妹方才说过，此毒无解。”顾怀谨走到沈江寒身旁，轻叹一声，“这位道友，莫要为难人。”

    那魁梧体修听到这些话，仿佛失去抵抗一般，眼中的清明彻底消失，突然，灵力暴乱，拔地而起，大笑着朝秘境深处飞奔而去。

    谢清猗从两位师兄中间探出脑袋，见忽然发疯奔走的男修，心中有些沉重，她果然无法做到修仙界的人那般看惯生死。

    这时那女修走到一旁，语带笑意：“我就知道，天极仙府这等第一仙府的弟子，定然不会与我等散修一般见识。”她目光在三人身上流转，最终定在沈江寒身上，“在下苏甜，不知三位道友，如何称呼？”

    “谢清猗。”谢清猗微微颔首，走到顾师兄身侧，给了他们个眼神示意，可两人仿佛没听见般。

    她替人尴尬的毛病又犯了，轻咳声，“这两位是顾师兄和沈师兄。”

    苏甜盈盈一礼，眼波流转间，嗓音更娇柔了些，带着恳求：“这秘境危机四伏，我独自一人，实在难保周全……不知可否让我随行？我定会谨守本分，绝不添乱。”

    顾怀瑾神色如常，略一沉吟便点头应下：“可以，苏道友便随我们同行吧。”他话锋微转，语气平和却带着提醒，“不过秘境之中危机四伏，我等也未必能时时护得道友周全，丑话说在前头，还望道友心中有数。”

    苏甜自是连声道谢，随即乖巧跟上谢清猗等人的脚步。一行人不再停留，绕过那几具已然气息奄奄或彻底疯癫的身影，朝着秘境更深处行去。

    身后，那几名触碰鬼草的散修中已有两人气绝身亡，双目圆睁，脸上凝固着诡异笑容，周身再无半点灵气。余下的也已神智尽失，口中嗬嗬作声，在昏暗角落里手舞足蹈，疯癫而去。

    众人沿着蜿蜒曲折，岔路繁多的通道小心前行。岩壁潮湿，滴滴答答的水声与远处隐隐传来的，不知名妖兽的低吼交织在一起。
content_en:
Seeing that the other party was just watching quietly without saying a word, the burly physique cultivator clenched his back molars, his face became more distorted due to his efforts to restrain himself, and he gasped: "You, at such an age... uh... know this poisonous weed." He groaned again, and bright red blood spilled from the corners of his lips, "Tao Ancestor... Tao Ancestor, a person like that... uh... can definitely save..."

    Before he finished speaking, more blood flowed out of his mouth. Xie Qingyi opened her eyes slightly. The fingertips of the hand that was not holding the sword sank deeply into her flesh. Her eyelashes trembled slightly. Although the man was mocking her in front of her, there was really nothing she could do. Master, she didn't know if she could save them...

    Shen Jianghan's eyes turned cold, his robe flicked with his movements, he took a step forward to block Xie Qingyi, and his clear voice deepened: "I wasn't allowed to take it off before, but now you are embarrassing my junior sister again."

    "Indeed, junior sister just said that there is no cure for this poison." Gu Huaijin walked to Shen Jianghan and sighed softly, "Fellow Taoist, please don't make things difficult for others."

    When the burly physique cultivator heard these words, he seemed to have lost his resistance, and the clarity in his eyes completely disappeared. Suddenly, his spiritual power was violent, he stood up from the ground, laughed and flew towards the depths of the secret realm.

    Xie Qingyi poked her head out from between the two senior brothers. When she saw the male cultivator suddenly running madly, her heart felt a little heavy. She really couldn't be as accustomed to life and death as people in the world of immortality.

    At this time, the female cultivator walked aside and said with a smile: "I knew that the disciples of the first Immortal Palace such as Tianji Immortal Palace would definitely not have the same experience as us and other casual cultivators." Her eyes moved around the three people, and finally settled on Shen Jianghan, "Su Tian, I don't know how to call these three fellow Taoists?"

    "Xie Qingyi." Xie Qingyi nodded slightly, walked to Senior Brother Gu, and gave them a look, but the two of them seemed not to hear.

    Her habit of being embarrassed came back again, and she coughed lightly, "These two are Senior Brother Gu and Senior Brother Shen."

    Su Tianying bowed, her eyes flashing, and her voice became softer and pleading: "This secret realm is full of dangers. I am alone, and it is really difficult to be safe... I wonder if you can let me accompany you? I will stick to my duty and never cause trouble."

    Gu Huaijin's expression remained as usual. He pondered for a moment before nodding in agreement: "Okay, Fellow Daoist Su, please come with us." He changed his topic slightly, and his tone was calm but with a reminder, "However, there are dangers in the secret realm, and we may not always be able to protect our fellow Daoist. There are ugly words ahead, and I hope that fellow Daoist is aware of it."

    Su Tian thanked her profusely, and then followed Xie Qingyi and others obediently. The group of people stopped stopping, bypassing the dying or completely crazy figures, and headed deeper into the secret realm.

    Behind him, two of the casual cultivators who had touched the ghost grass died of anger. Their eyes were wide open, with weird smiles on their faces, and there was no trace of aura around them. The rest have also lost all their consciousness, making hoho sounds in their mouths, dancing around in the dark corners, and going crazy.

    Everyone walked carefully along the winding passage with many forks. The rock wall was damp, and the sound of dripping water was intertwined with the faint roar of an unknown monster in the distance.
